name: Z-ITAR International Traffic in Arms Regulations-Monitor
CUI-Block-Marked-Documents
description: Inline Web DLP: block uploads carrying high-precision CUI markings (banners, category tokens, legacy FOUO/LES/SBU, distribution statements) via CUI-Detect-Block-Grade. Ships DISABLED at INFO; enable after reviewing monitor incidents from CUI-Monitor-All.

name: CUI-Caution-Weak-Markings
description: Inline Web DLP: caution (user must confirm) on lower-precision CUI signals: bare CUI, standalone LDCs, malformed markings, designation blocks, via CUI-Detect-Caution-Grade. Never BLOCK on these.

name: CUI-Monitor-All
description: Inline Web DLP: monitor-only rule over the full CUI-Detect-All surface plus the content-based CUI-Detect-Contextual signal. Enable this first to size incident volume and tune before enabling the block and caution rules above it.
